CHALDEAN-MATURITY-001.say: As you grow older, your desire for independence, standing and recognition increases. You may resist teamwork when challenged, feel lonely or misunderstood, and find failure or a junior role harder to handle.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-004.say: With age you become a harmoniser: aggression fades as cooperation, tact and diplomacy grow. You become more organised and build networks, though you may need to accept less fame.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-007.say: This number is a blessing: later in life you become radiant, outgoing and creative in writing, painting, acting or music. Recognition, fame and happiness may come, with roles as advisor or mentor.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-009.say: With age you become more practical and organised, focused on material achievement and turning ideas into reality. You care about legacy, family and community welfare, and stay loyal.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-013.say: Your later years can be a thrilling roller coaster of freedom, adventure, socialising and travel, with good verbal skills and creativity. Stay focused and take care not to become reckless.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-020.say: With age you become philosophical and wise, drawn to reading and contemplation, with sharper intuition. You value privacy and solitude, though not too much, and scepticism can cause friction.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-024.say: Later life can bring material achievement, a public profile and responsibility, with comfortable finances through discipline and saving. You may take up social causes; do not cling to power, money or ego.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-027.say: This number is considered a divine gift of completion: after struggle you grow close to higher powers and in harmony with the five elements. You become an agent of change for public welfare.

CHALDEAN-MATURITY-029.say: Like maturity 2, you grow into a harmoniser, but with your intuition greatly amplified, even clairvoyant. You can become a healer, occult practitioner or researcher, with premonitions and deep spirituality.
